paragraphs.en: I have a confession to make. It has taken me years to write this article.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一件事坦白。我花了好几年才写完这篇文章。

paragraphs.en: For a long time, I have felt that something was missing in the public conversation about human connection and community and how they are being eroded.
paragraphs.zh: 长久以来，我总觉得，大众探讨人际联结、社群关系，以及二者正不断消解的话题里，始终缺失某种关键东西。

paragraphs.en: And yet I haven't been able to articulate it. Thinking and writing have become harder.
paragraphs.zh: 可我一直无法清晰地把它表达出来。思考与写作变得愈发艰难。

paragraphs.en: It's as if the neurons in my brain don't connect with each other in quite the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 仿佛我大脑里的神经元，不再以从前的方式建立联结。

paragraphs.en: I go to check a fact and get instantly diverted by a hundred other distractions on my phone.
paragraphs.zh: 我想去核实一则事实，结果手机里成百上千条信息瞬间就会分散我的注意力。

paragraphs.en: I find myself unable to devote time to thinking and writing like I used to.
paragraphs.zh: 我再也无法像从前那样，静下心思考、动笔写作。

paragraphs.en: It could be the relentless news agenda, but the news has been relentless throughout my 11 years as editor-in-chief of the Guardian.
paragraphs.zh: 或许是源源不断的新闻事件所致，但我担任《卫报》主编的十一年间，新闻从来不曾间断。

paragraphs.en: It could be age, but I'm not that old. It could be menopause, but I'm on all the drugs.
paragraphs.zh: 或许是年纪增长，但我并不算老。或许是更年期，但我一直在服药调理。

paragraphs.en: No, I think it's because of something that many of us feel in this moment.
paragraphs.zh: 不，我认为根源是我们当下很多人共同感受到的一种状态。

paragraphs.en: That our attention spans have been degraded, our thinking skills blunted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的注意力时长大幅衰退，思辨能力也变得迟钝。

paragraphs.en: That we somehow can't concentrate or lose ourselves in a project.
paragraphs.zh: 我们难以集中精神，也无法全身心投入一件事。

paragraphs.en: Finding myself stuck, as an experiment, I asked an AI tool to write this article for me, just to see what it came up with.
paragraphs.zh: 写作陷入瓶颈，我做了一个尝试，让人工智能工具替我撰写这篇文章，只想看看它会生成怎样的内容。

paragraphs.en: The result was insufferably pompous and joyless.
paragraphs.zh: 结果写出来的文字浮夸空洞，毫无真情实感，令人难以忍受。

paragraphs.en: A reminder of the limits of this technology, for now at least.
paragraphs.zh: 这也提醒我们，至少现阶段，这项技术存在局限。

paragraphs.en: In the end, I managed to write this article thanks to some serious interventions: the force of a deadline, locking my phone in a different room, turning off the internet.
paragraphs.zh: 最终我还是靠一系列强制约束写完了这篇文章：严格的截稿期限、把手机锁进另一个房间、断开网络。

paragraphs.en: But what really got me there, got me to being able to say what I wanted to say, was talking it through with friends and colleagues.
paragraphs.zh: 但真正帮我理清思路、顺畅表达内心想法的，是和朋友、同事反复交谈梳理。

paragraphs.en: The answer to my writer's block was in front of me all along: all I needed to do was to talk to other people.
paragraphs.zh: 破解写作瓶颈的答案其实一直摆在眼前：我只需要多和他人交流。

paragraphs.en: Our age of crises
paragraphs.zh: 危机四起的时代

paragraphs.en: I'm sure you feel it too. The world really has become a more bewildering, less hopeful place.
paragraphs.zh: 我相信你也深有同感。这个世界确实变得愈发令人迷茫，希望也愈发稀薄。

paragraphs.en: Just look at the headlines in recent weeks: from a shocking spike in antisemitic attacks in the UK, to Donald Trump's threats to blow Iran "off the face of the earth", to daily stories of war and mass displacement.
paragraphs.zh: 只需看看近几周的新闻头条：英国反犹袭击事件急剧激增、唐纳德·特朗普扬言要把伊朗“从地球上抹掉”，还有层出不穷的战争与大规模流离失所的报道。

paragraphs.en: There are always positive stories, of course – of bravery, invention, creativity and kindness.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，世间从不缺正向新闻——关于勇气、创新、创造力与善意的故事。

paragraphs.en: But you're right to have a growing sense that we are living in an age of crisis – of many interlinked crises – and that our collective survival is at stake.
paragraphs.zh: 但你会愈发真切地意识到，我们正身处一个危机四伏的时代，各类危机环环相扣，人类整体的存续都岌岌可危。

paragraphs.en: I'm going to talk about the challenges we face as fellow citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我想谈谈身为普通公民，我们共同面临的种种挑战。

paragraphs.en: And I hope to persuade you that good information, transparently funded journalism in the public interest, is part of the solution to the problem in more ways than you might think.
paragraphs.zh: 同时我希望说服你，依托透明资金运营、以公共利益为导向的优质新闻报道，能从诸多层面为化解危机提供解决方案，其作用远超你的想象。

paragraphs.en: But first: these crises. I'm sure they will be familiar. At the grandest scale: the environmental crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 首先先说说各类危机，这些问题想必你都耳熟能详。从宏观层面来讲，是气候危机。

paragraphs.en: In February, scientists warned that the world is closer than previously thought to a "point of no return" after which runaway global heating cannot be stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 今年二月，科学家发出警示：地球距离“不可逆临界点”比此前预想的更近，一旦越过这道门槛，失控的全球变暖将再也无法遏制。

paragraphs.en: The global food system is under threat and wildlife populations have declined by more than 70% since 1970.
paragraphs.zh: 全球粮食体系正遭受威胁，1970年至今，野生动物种群数量降幅超七成。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the global consensus on the need for urgent action has been attacked by rightwing populists as an elite concern, just as the poorest suffer most from the climate catastrophe.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，右翼民粹主义者大肆抨击全球共识下的紧急气候行动，称其只是精英阶层的议题，可承受气候灾难冲击最严重的，恰恰是底层弱势群体。

paragraphs.en: There is also the global political crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 其次是全球政治危机。

paragraphs.en: For the first time in 20 years, autocracies outnumber democracies.
paragraphs.zh: 二十年来，威权国家数量首次超过民主国家。

paragraphs.en: Even in many established democracies we are seeing the dismantling of democratic norms, the erosion of checks and balances.
paragraphs.zh: 即便是诸多老牌民主国家，民主规范也在不断瓦解，权力制衡机制持续弱化。

paragraphs.en: Just look at the US.
paragraphs.zh: 美国就是典型例子。

paragraphs.en: As Staffan Lindberg, the founder of the V-Dem Institute in Gothenburg, says: "For Orban in Hungary, it took about four years; for Vucic in Serbia, it took eight years, and for Erdogan in Turkey and Modi in India, it took about 10 years to accomplish the suppression of democratic institutions that Donald Trump has achieved in only one year."
paragraphs.zh: 哥德堡大学民主多样性研究所创始人斯塔凡·林德伯格表示：“匈牙利的欧尔班用了约四年、塞尔维亚的武契奇用了八年、土耳其埃尔多安与印度莫迪各花了约十年，才一步步削弱本国民主制度；而唐纳德·特朗普仅用一年，就达成了同等程度的破坏。”
